offers.name: YouTube Channel Manager
offers.pitch: An AI employee rewrites your YouTube titles, descriptions, chapters, tags and thumbnails. A person at Linkfa checks every change, and nothing changes on your channel until you reply YES.
offers.freeHook: A free channel audit summary plus 1 free video makeover, applied only after you say YES.

tiers.name: Tune-up
includes: Up to 8 video makeovers a month
Title, description with chapters, tags and thumbnail for each video
Back catalogue first, highest reach first
Channel audit at the start and every month

tiers.name: Growth
includes: Up to 20 video makeovers a month
Every new upload made over, within that cap
4 designed thumbnails a month in your brand
Channel audit at the start and every month
Monthly report and a short weekly WhatsApp update

tiers.name: Studio
includes: Up to 40 video makeovers a month
A designed thumbnail for every makeover
